name: Cube Steak
body:
Station and Complexity boucher 1, rotisseur 1

Flavor Profiles umami
Additional Ingredients bitter, salty, sour, spicy, sweet, temperature, or texture

EFFECT

Duration 1 minute/level; Serving Size 1

DESCRIPTION

Cube steak is a meat pounded thin and seasoned lightly before cooking.

When consumed, it grants an attack that can be made with proficiency for the duration. This attack counts as a one-handed melee weapon in the hammer family that deals 1d6 + strength modifier bludgeoning damage with a critical multiplier of x3.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 and the damage by +1d6 each, to a maximum of +1d6 per 2 levels.
